changelog: **Speed cap for the External Correction.** A new "Max Speed" (counts/s) caps how fast the correction moves — it excludes sudden distance-driven jumps. It is the *nominal* ceiling: with scatter on, the actual cap is jittered up and down per frame so a saturating correction never sits on a constant value. On by default at 1500 cr/s (roomy for normal aim, only clips spikes); 0 = off.

**Movement scatter.** The correction no longer travels a dead-straight line to the target: an independent Gaussian is applied to the X and Y speed, re-drawn once per frame and held between frames, so the path curves. Sigma is in % of the computed speed. On by default at 20 %.

**Trigger start delay (offset).** After you press the trigger button the correction now starts after a short, Gaussian-jittered delay (reaction-time feel) instead of instantly. Default 120 ms ± 15 %; set it right under the trigger selection. "Always" has no trigger, so no delay.

**Ext-Corr parameter sets in the control app.** New "Satz speichern" / "Satz laden" buttons store and restore the whole Ext-Corr parameter set as a .json, plus "Setzen (an FW)" to push every value to the device and read it back for confirmation.
